standard-dialogue-before-delivering-thei.npc: Hmm, interesting place this. It feels a little like Kelda, except without the good bits.

standard-dialogue-before-delivering-thei.speaker: Grundt
standard-dialogue-before-delivering-thei.text: Bored, bored, bored. These Fremenniks are taking ages.

standard-dialogue-before-delivering-thei.player: Hey, they're doing their best. You arrived early.

standard-dialogue-before-delivering-thei.speaker: Grundt
standard-dialogue-before-delivering-thei.text: Hey, we arrived precisely when we told your representatives. Lack of planning on your part does not constitute an emergency on my part.

standard-dialogue-before-delivering-thei.speaker: Vanligga Gastfrihet
standard-dialogue-before-delivering-thei.text: Please, someone get these guys their ore quickly. They are eating all the good food on the island, and complaining about it!

standard-dialogue-before-delivering-thei.player: I'd better get a move on!

standard-dialogue-after-delivering-their.npc: Well it seemed rude not to finish the food they gave us.

standard-dialogue-after-delivering-their.speaker: Vanligga Gastfrihet
standard-dialogue-after-delivering-their.text: Feel free to leave it. Please leave.

standard-dialogue-after-delivering-their.speaker: Grundt
standard-dialogue-after-delivering-their.text: I'll just finish the roast off.
